results.title: PAN AFRICAN RESOURCES PLC - Full Year Results | Investor Meet Company
results.content: Pan African Resources Plc (AIM:PAF) delivered a strong investor update highlighting record performance, strategic growth, and enhanced shareholder returns. The gold producer reported FY25 production of nearly 200,000 ounces, underpinned by high-margin surface and underground operations across South Africa and Australia. Guidance for FY26 points to a significant 40% increase in output to at least 275,000 ounces, supported by flagship projects such as the Mintails Tailings Retreatment (MTR) and newly commissioned Tennant Mines in Australia. The company emphasized its robust balance sheet, competitive all-in sustaining costs, and sector-leading dividend policy, with an 80% increase in proposed dividends and ongoing share buybacks. Pan African continues to invest in expanding production [...] Pan African continues to invest in expanding production capacity, advancing exploration, and strengthening ESG commitments, including renewable energy and water recycling initiatives. Management confirmed the group is now fully unhedged, providing investors with full exposure to gold price upside, while maintaining disciplined capital allocation and a track record of delivering projects on time and within budget. With a planned move to the London Stock Exchange’s main market, Pan African aims to broaden its shareholder base and attract institutional investors. The company’s growth strategy, supported by long-life assets, rising margins, and operational efficiencies, positions it as one of the few mid-tier gold producers capable of delivering both production growth and sustainable cash [...] of delivering both production growth and sustainable cash returns in the current strong gold price environment.

# Pan African Resources confirms production, revenue and earnings growth for 2025

Published: 08:59 04 Sep 2025 BST

Pan African Resources PLC - 

Pan African Resources PLC (AIM:PAF, OTCQX:PAFRY, JSE:PAN) told investors that earnings for the year ended 30 June are expected to rise sharply, driven by higher gold prices and increased sales volumes.

The miner, in a trading statement ahead of reporting the results later this month, said it expects to report earnings per share of between 6.95 and 7.37 US cents, up 68% to 78% from a year earlier.

Headline earnings per share are expected between 5.68 and 6.10 US cents, reflecting a 37% to 47% increase. [...] PAF anticipates a 44.5% rise in revenue, due to a 35.7% increase in the average gold price to US$2,735 per ounce and a 6.5% rise in gold sold to 196,926 ounces.

The company noted that 105,004 ounces of sales were hedged during the year, but confirmed it was fully unhedged since July.
